name: Hand-drawn Collage
visualIdentity: Layer hand-drawn characters, handwritten text, and cut paper in a shared brush and paper language. Uneven edges, tape, and light contact shadows support the crafted feel; the style is explicitly described as a visual direction.
suitableUses: Works alone for crafted narratives. Suggested hybrids suit explainers, educational content, craft stories, and social clips. For interactive HTML, paper diagrams can use accessible labels and placement animations can use stepped timing. These are inferred fits from the suggested combinations.
limitations: Avoid continuous wobble, boiling every layer, overlapping layers, glossy charts, and added colors. Keep diagrams accurate. Use stepped timing only for placement, with no line boil. No other universal exclusions are specified.
palette: Optional new-artwork suggestion: background #F6EDD9, foreground #3C4345, accents #B97259 and #819777. Use discrete tokens; gradients are disabled. Supplied exact colors, approved palettes, semantic roles, source art, color families, and count constraints take precedence. Accent/background contrast is insufficient for normal text; verify actual composites.
motionAndInteraction: Separate paper, lettering, and character parts; use shared textures and explicit pivots for placing, peeling, hinging, and recomposition. Avoid constant wobble. Optional stepped placement may be animated on twos. Interactive HTML can map scroll to story stages or pinned recomposition; video must use timed, seekable states, not live input.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, narration, vocals, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied assets and requirements. Synchronize and mix with picture, keeping speech clear and avoiding clipping or competing vocals.
assetRequirements: Prepare transparent, consistently sized and clearly named layers or numbered frames; preserve alpha. Separate paper pieces, lettering, and character parts, with shared paper textures and explicit pivots. Python/Pillow or Node.js/Sharp can preprocess assets; Rough.js can generate seeded sketch contours but does not create handwriting, paper texture, brush simulation, or character poses.
combinations: Suggested diagram hybrid: style-097 Rough.js diagrams on paper, with the primary palette and same ink weight; keep data accurate. Suggested cadence hybrid: style-082 stepped placement, shared textures, no line boil or added colors. Other combinations are unspecified.
productionApproach: Select visual and motion tools for fidelity and assets first; PixiJS and Rough.js are optional renderer options. Use HyperFrames for assembly, seekable timing, sync, validation, and export; Remotion only if unavailable or a verified required capability is blocked, recording why. Keep rendering and motion responsibilities separate. Use composition-time deterministic state for video; scroll or pointer input only for interactive HTML.
